chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa from Ibn Muskān from Ibn Abī Ya'fūr from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
"When the woman prostrates, she spreads her two arms."
ai.seo_question: How should a woman position her arms when prostrating in Islamic prayer?
ai.summary: Reported by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) details the specific etiquette of female prostration, emphasizing modesty by spreading the arms to minimize the exposure of the body's contours. This ruling is central to Shia fiqh discussions on the distinction between male and female prayer postures, reflecting the principle of *satr* (covering) within the prayer space.
